long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Salt Lake City in 1955, Steven C. Thomas grew up in Las Vegas and graduated from the University of Utah as valedictorian of his college. After formal orthopaedic training, a travelling fellowship took him to the Hospital for Special Surgery in New York and to Southern California for advanced instruction in arthroscopic techniques.

Thomas's clinical work developed around sports injuries, ligament reconstruction and minimally invasive treatment of knee and shoulder disorders. He also maintained a broader general-orthopaedic practice. Board certification in orthopaedic surgery and a subspecialty certificate in orthopaedic sports medicine formalised that focus, while publications and textbook chapters extended his contribution beyond the operating room.
